items.problem: CA1416 platform-compatibility warnings on DatePicker/TimePicker/Calendar/Pedometer history APIs.
items.evidence: build-output.txt tail: dozens of CA1416 warnings; BUILD SUCCEEDED; app ran and scored 100/100.
items.covered_clearly_at: N/A — not an error and not a defect: warnings are non-blocking, the build succeeds and the app runs. No skill change warranted.
items.why_no_skill_change: CA1416 are advisory warnings inherent to targeting a min platform below an API's introduced version; they do not affect build success, runtime, or parity. Documenting them would add noise without changing any outcome.
